incident-bot: [P1] Edge POP connectivity degradation detected in eu-west-1 -> sustained packet loss to CDN POP 51.140.23.*/24, error rate > 7% for last 6m. Alert INC-2026-2012. Root thread started 1774007890
Marta (oncall-sre): got the page, pinging cdn vendor and checking our egress/peering table. tagging netops.
Raj (netops): pulling BGP sessions now. seeing flaps to a handful of prefixes from provider X (ASN 64512). suspicious: last-hop loss, looks like upstream congestion not origin.
Sophie (support): we have multiple customer reports — chat generation times out and streaming stalls. Customer-facing incident page: setting "degraded in EU".
Ellen (edge-eng): stack traces show retries hitting our fallback model tiers, token throughput drop ~40%. Edge cache hit rate unchanged. implies last-mile/edge POP issue, not origin CPU.
Marta (oncall-sre): running quick traceroutes to the POP IP from our eu-west instances, posting results.
Marta (oncall-sre): ```
traceroute to 51.140.23.18 (51.140.23.18), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.2.1  0.23 ms  0.21 ms  0.19 ms
 2  100.64.0.1  1.02 ms  1.05 ms  1.01 ms
 3  203.0.113.5  12.49 ms  12.40 ms  12.37 ms
 4  198.51.100.11  25.66 ms  25.62 ms  25.58 ms
 5  51.140.23.18  120.33 ms  *  118.90 ms
```
Raj (netops): traceroute shows intermittent * at final hop and high latency spikes. BGP looking odd: multiple path prepends from provider X, maybe a routing policy loop. Opening ticket with provider X now (TCK-98721).
edge-monitor-bot: Observability: increased retransmits and TCP resets at POP host 51.140.23.18 between 09:10-09:28 UTC. Correlated with increased customer error rate.
Marta (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic to alternate CDN POPs (eu-central / eu-north) via traffic steering rule; 2) failover to direct origin egress for critical customers; 3) throttle streaming chunk size to reduce sessions. Which do we want now?
Ellen (edge-eng): I can push traffic steering to prefer eu-central. It takes ~2m to propagate. Recommend steering + origin fallback for enterprise tenants.
Ian (account-ops): flagging impacted enterprise accounts with live incidents: AcmeCorp and Logix saw >20% failed requests. They need an ETA.
Sophie (support): updating status page: "We are experiencing degraded connectivity to our CDN edge in EU West. Engineers are investigating. Some customers may see increased latency or timeouts." Will include estimated ETA after mitigation.
Raj (netops): provider X says they're seeing packet drops in one of their peering routers, they've applied a temporary fix but it's not stable. They suggested BGP withdraw and re-advertise from their POP to clear the path.
Marta (oncall-sre): rolling out traffic steering now: shift 60% of EU west traffic to eu-central pop. I'll monitor error rate and latency.
edge-monitor-bot: Traffic steering change propagated at 09:22:13 UTC.
Marta (oncall-sre): early indicators: error rate down from 7% -> 1.8% across affected routes. Latency normalized for steered traffic. Still seeing a small % failing on direct eu-west attempts.
Ellen (edge-eng): pushing origin-direct fallback for enterprise API keys for AcmeCorp & Logix. route set applied.
Ian (account-ops): confirming with AcmeCorp; they're seeing recovery in webhooks and chat sessions. Noted for postmortem communication.
Sophie (support): status page updated: "Mitigation in flight: traffic steered to alternate POPs; partial recovery observed. We will post updates every 15 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj (netops): provider X reports they've stabilized the peering router after re-ad and are re-advertising prefixes. but warning: they may still see flaps for 15-30m.
Marta (oncall-sre): setting oncall-handoff to Ellen in 40m. Leaving a clear incident bridge note.
Ellen (edge-eng): taking over. I'll keep the steering in place until provider confirms sustained stability for 1h, then gradually shift traffic back.
Marta (oncall-sre): escalation checklist completed: pager acknowledged, vendor ticket opened (TCK-98721), enterprise customers notified, mitigations applied. Adding to incident log.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-2012 updated: severity P1 -> mitigation in progress. Bridge: #incident-1774007890-bridge.
Sophie (support): few customers asking for root cause. Can we say "upstream CDN peering instability at provider X causing packet loss to eu-west POP"?
Raj (netops): that's accurate for now. final root cause pending vendor RCA. Avoid naming internal configuration changes.
Ellen (edge-eng): note for postmortem: consider adding automated dynamic steering when POP loss >3% for >5m, and a graceful stream fallback to reduce session churn.
Ian (account-ops): I'll prepare customer-facing post-incident note for impacted enterprise accounts after RCA.
Marta (oncall-sre): handing off now to Ellen. Handoff summary: steering applied -> errors down -> vendor says stabilized -> monitor 1h -> postmortem + RCA. Any other asks before I sign off?
Ellen (edge-eng): none. thanks Marta. I'll keep the channel updated.
edge-monitor-bot: Last alert cleared at 09:45:02 UTC, error rate below threshold. Continuing monitoring for 1h.
Ellen (edge-eng): marking incident as mitigated in our internal tracker. Will create postmortem draft once vendor RCA is available.
Sophie (support): closing customer impact thread in support queue, leaving notes for follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-2012 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Close target: 1774011400
